meta.name: split-pr
meta.description: Analyzes current changes and suggests how to split them into smaller, reviewable PRs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大改动拆成可审查的小PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常提交大PR被要求拆分
copy.tagline_en: Split large changes into reviewable small PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get asked to split your large PRs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析当前代码变更，判断是否过大，然后建议拆分成多个更小、更易审查的拉取请求（PR），并给出每个 PR 的文件、大小和创建顺序。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 分析当前分支的变更，或询问如何拆分一个大的拉取请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析当前变更，建议拆分成几个小 PR。
say.note: Claude 会执行 git diff 并给出拆分方案。

say.text: 这个 PR 太大了，帮我拆分一下。
say.note: Claude 会评估变更并推荐拆分策略。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the current code changes, determines if they are too large, and suggests splitting them into smaller, more reviewable pull requests (PRs), including files, size, and creation order for each PR.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to analyze the current branch changes or request to split a large pull request.

say_en.text: Analyze my current changes and suggest splitting into smaller PRs.
say_en.note: Claude will run git diff and propose a split strategy.

say_en.text: This PR is too large, help me split it.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate the changes and recommend a split.
